fix: tryHandleUnscopedCartKitchenNote (orchestrator, in the note chain after the partial-unit handler; two or more cart lines, no pending selection, no question): «(y) (las) (N) (de ellas) sin/poco/poca X» that names no cart line and is not an option of a cart product. A count equal to every unit notes all lines; a count above the total asks without changes; otherwise the existing pendingSubsetKitchenNote list (byUnits) is opened. The scoped note over several lines of different products opens the same list; same-product lines keep a text answer that now names each line and its note. The subset-note answer falls back to uniqueClarificationLine, so «la doble», «el perro» or an ordinal resolve. A single-unit question reads «¿Cuál producto lleva la nota «X»? (1 unidad)».
